svg.title: One outreach workflow shared by Telegram and the dashboard
svg.desc: A goal and optional files enter through private Telegram or the owner dashboard. Local extraction reads document text and OCR before file evidence guides interpretation and research. Both use a durable job queue and one worker running LangGraph. The workflow interprets the goal, researches evidence with Brave and a public browser, qualifies prospects, resolves recipient addresses, checks memory and contact policy, creates a strategy, writes and reviews email, pauses for human approval, and records an approved Gmail action. Edits return to review; blocked or rejected work ends with a saved outcome. SQLite holds progress, decisions, and events for both interfaces.
